mission_09: Outstanding! You have successfully created aggregation features from granular transaction data. You learned how to use groupby with agg() to compute multiple statistics simultaneously, derive temporal features like tenure and transaction frequency, and merge the results into a customer-level feature table. This aggregation pattern is the backbone of feature engineering for tabular data. Whether you are working with customer transactions, sensor readings, or user activity logs, the ability to summarize granular data into entity-level features is an essential skill for any data scientist.
